instruction:
Using the official npm Registry response for the latest TypeScript package, report the package name, version, license, Node.js engine requirement, unpacked size in bytes, and file count.

Stopping condition: Stop after all six requested fields have been recorded from the registry response.

Constraints:
- Use the official npm Registry response at the supplied URL.
- Read the Node.js requirement from engines.node, unpacked size from dist.unpackedSize, and file count from dist.fileCount.
- Preserve version, license, requirement, and numeric values exactly; do not convert bytes to another unit.
- Do not download or install the package.
